name: Friedman NBG* fourteen-sentence membership reduct (specified normalization)
status: finite first-order source target; full modal translation and binary machine absent

language.relation: one binary R, interpreted as membership
language.domain: nonempty, containing both sets and proper classes when present

normalization.set_predicate: M(x) := exists y R(x,y), using fresh bound variables
normalization.omitted_row: 1 Sets becomes a logical alpha-equivalence and is omitted
normalization.universal_closure: all formerly free axiom parameters are explicitly universally bound
normalization.union_typo: section 2 printed v2 in the union body is read as the quantified candidate element v(i+1)
normalization.boolean_scope: row A conjoins two independent existence assertions, with fresh witness names
normalization.infinity_scope: the set witness scopes over nonemptiness and the entire no-maximal-member property
normalization.foundation_scope: class nonemptiness is written as an existential antecedent
normalization.choice: No Choice axiom or global Choice is added

source_proof_notes: Lemma 2.1 discusses Union Inclusion where row F is Union Membership; Lemma 3.1 discusses the actual membership form.
Lemma 3.19's second negated existential in the equality case prints an implication; intended extensionality uses a conjunction with negated membership.
Lemma 3.20's coded class A needs two successive Class Union operations to recover its selected members and possible tags; the printed single union is one level short.

Theorem 3.21's displayed Collection coding has a coordinate-alias gap; use {x,{b,y}} with b not in union(A), rather than {x,{x,y}}. Capture then cannot cover an element of A through the second component. This changes no axiom.
The generator follows intended axioms; it does not serialize or independently formalize the full proof of Theorem 3.21.

calibration_contract.ordinary_result: ZFC proves Con(U14) iff Con(choice-free NBG) iff Con(ZF) iff Con(ZFC)
calibration_contract.basis: definitional elimination of M; cited NBG* equivalence with documented proof repairs; definable-class expansion/reduct; constructible-universe relative consistency
calibration_contract.choice_caveat: Con(ZF) to Con(ZFC) uses the standard L interpretation, not the presence of Choice among these fourteen sentences
calibration_contract.machine_claim: None: no modal target emission or binary TM is supplied by this generator
